The '''Koban Gorge''' was an expansive canyon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koba]]. The valley was set between two cliffs and filled with abundant forest land, with a bridge that connected one side to the other. More than two hundred years before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Polvin Kut]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the bridge overlooking the Koban Gorge by [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] warriors rallied under the banner of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Tulak]]. A century later, the native [[Koban]] people reconstructed [[Polvin Kut memorial bridge|the bridge]] and through it memorialized Kut, whose likeness was carved into the structure.
